```{r}
library(r4ss)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

theme_sleek <- function (base_size = 11, base_family = "") 
{
    half_line <- base_size/2
    theme_light(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) + 
        theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
              axis.ticks.length = unit(half_line/2.2, "pt"), 
              strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA), 
              axis.text = element_text(colour = "grey30"), 
              axis.title = element_text(colour = "grey30"), 
              legend.title = element_text(colour = "grey30", size = rel(0.9)), 
              panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 1), 
              legend.key.size = unit(0.9, "lines"), 
              legend.text = element_text(size = rel(0.7), colour = "grey30"), 
              legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA, fill = NA), 
              legend.background = element_rect(colour = NA, fill = NA), 
              plot.title = element_text(colour = "grey30", size = rel(1)), 
              plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey30", size = rel(0.85)), 
              strip.text = element_text(colour = "grey30"))
}

theme_set(theme_sleek())

pal <- c(rev(LaCroixColoR::lacroix_palette('Orange', 5)), '#EE2C2C')

cod_om <- SS_read(here('inst/extdata/models/cod/om'))
cod_ctl <- cod_om$ctl

petrale_om <- SS_read(here('inst/extdata/models/petrale/om'))
petrale_ctl <- petrale_om$ctl

cod_om_rep <- SS_output(here('simulations/cod/no.ind/1/om'), verbose = FALSE, printstats = FALSE)
petrale_om_rep <- SS_output(here('simulations/petrale/no.ind/1/om'), verbose = FALSE, printstats = FALSE)

read_sim_output <- function(filepath, max_grad_criteria = 0.1) {
  scalar <- file.path(filepath, 'ss3sim_scalar.csv') |>
    readr::read_csv() |>
    mutate(scenario = ifelse(scenario == 'no.ind', 'No index_10', scenario)) |>
    tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cols = scenario, delim = "_", names = c('scenario', 'nyr')) |>
    mutate(nyr = as.numeric(nyr)) %>%
    bind_rows({filter(., scenario == 'No index') |> 
        mutate(nyr = 30)})
  
  bad_sims <- scalar |>
    filter(max_grad > max_grad_criteria) |>
    select(iteration, scenario, nyr)
  
  scalar_filtered <- anti_join(scalar, bad_sims)
  
  ts <- file.path(filepath, 'ss3sim_ts.csv') |>
    readr::read_csv() |>
    mutate(scenario = ifelse(scenario == 'no.ind', 'No index_10', scenario)) |>
    tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cols = scenario, delim = "_", names = c('scenario', 'nyr')) |>
    mutate(nyr = as.numeric(nyr)) %>%
    bind_rows({filter(., scenario == 'No index') |> # replicate no index rows for both index lengths (for plotting ease)
        mutate(nyr = 30)}) |>
    anti_join(bad_sims)
  
  dq <- file.path(filepath, 'ss3sim_dq.csv') |>
    readr::read_csv() |>
    mutate(scenario = ifelse(scenario == 'no.ind', 'No index_10', scenario)) |>
    tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cols = scenario, delim = "_", names = c('scenario', 'nyr')) |>
    mutate(nyr = as.numeric(nyr)) %>%
    bind_rows({filter(., scenario == 'No index') |> 
        mutate(nyr = 30)}) |>
    anti_join(bad_sims)
  
  message(paste0(nrow(bad_sims), 
                 ' simulations were filtered out of ', 
                 filepath, 
                 ' due to exceeding the maximum gradient criterion of ',
                 max_grad_criteria,
                 '. They are:'))
  
  return(list(ts = ts, scalar = scalar_filtered, dq = dq, bad_sims = bad_sims))
}

sim_names <- c('cod', 
               'cod_high_sigR',
               'petrale',
               'petrale_high_sigR',
               # 'petrale_high_sigR_high_index_se',
               NULL
               )
big_res <- here::here('simulations', sim_names) |>
  `names<-`(sim_names) |>
  purrr::map(read_sim_output)

ts <- purrr::map(big_res, purrr::pluck, 'ts') |>
  bind_rows(.id = 'ID') |>
  mutate(species = stringr::str_to_title(stringr::str_extract(ID, '^[:alpha:]+')), # any number of letters starting at beginning
         sigR = ifelse(grepl('_high_sigR', ID), 'high', 'low'),
         indexSE = ifelse(grepl('index_se', ID), 'high', 'low')) |> 
         # + 1) * # = 1 if low, 2 if high
           # ifelse(species == 'Cod', 0.4, 0.5)) |> # these are the baseline sigma Rs for each species
  select(-ID)

ts_long <- ts |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(Bio_smry:raw_rec_dev, retainB_2:F_2)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = model_run, values_from = value, 
                     id_cols = c(iteration, scenario, year, name, species, nyr, sigR)) |>
  filter(!is.na(em)) |> 
  group_by(species, nyr, name, scenario, year, sigR) |>
  summarise(mare = mean(abs((em-om)/om)),
            mre = mean((em-om)/om))|>
  mutate(year = ifelse(species == 'Petrale', year - petrale_om$dat$styr + 1, year))

scalar <- purrr::map(big_res, purrr::pluck, 'scalar') |>
  bind_rows(.id = 'ID') |>
  mutate(species = stringr::str_to_title(stringr::str_extract(ID, '^[:alpha:]+')), # any number of letters starting at beginning
         sigR = ifelse(grepl('_high_sigR', ID), 'high', 'low'),
         indexSE = ifelse(grepl('index_se', ID), 'high', 'low')) |> 
         # + 1) * # = 1 if low, 2 if high
           # ifelse(species == 'Cod', 0.4, 0.5)) |> # these are the baseline sigma Rs for each species
  select(-ID)

dq <- purrr::map(big_res, purrr::pluck, 'dq') |>
  bind_rows(.id = 'ID') |>
  mutate(species = stringr::str_to_title(stringr::str_extract(ID, '^[:alpha:]+')), # any number of letters starting at beginning
         sigR = ifelse(grepl('_high_sigR', ID), 'high', 'low'),
         indexSE = ifelse(grepl('index_se', ID), 'high', 'low')) |> 
         # + 1) * # = 1 if low, 2 if high
           # ifelse(species == 'Cod', 0.4, 0.5)) |> # these are the baseline sigma Rs for each species
  select(-ID)

dq_long <- dq |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(Value.SSB:Value.lnSPB) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = model_run, values_from = value, 
                     id_cols = c(iteration, scenario, year, name, species, nyr, sigR)) |>
  filter(!is.na(em), !is.na(om)) |> 
  mutate(re = (em-om)/om) |>
  group_by(species, nyr, name, scenario, year, sigR) |> 
  summarise(mare = mean(abs(re)),
            mre = mean(re),
            mare_bounds = tibble::as_tibble_row(quantile(abs(re), probs = c(0.05, 0.95)))) |>
  mutate(year = ifelse(species == 'Petrale', year - petrale_om$dat$styr + 1, year))

bad_sims <- purrr::map(big_res, purrr::pluck, 'bad_sims') |>
  bind_rows(.id = 'ID')

stat1 <- dq |>
  filter(year %in% c(112, 2034), model_run == 'em', nyr == 10, sigR == 'low') |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(species, iteration), 
    names_from = scenario, 
    values_from = Value.Bratio
  ) |> 
  mutate(diff = `No index` - `0.05`) |> summarize(mean(diff > 0))
```

```{r}
par_names <- c('Steepness',
               'log of unfished recruitment',
               'Std. dev. of log-recruitment deviations',
               'Natural mortality',
               'Young age',
               'Length at young age',
               'CV of length at young age',
               'Old age',
               'Length at old age',
               'CV of length at old age',
               'Von Bertalanffy growth rate',
               'Length at 50\\% maturity',
               'Imputed age near 60\\% maturity',
               'Imputed age at 50\\% survey selectivity',
               'Adult survey catchability'
)

par_symb <-  c(
  '$h$', '$\\log(R_0)$', '$\\sigma_R$', '$M$', 
  '$A_{\\min}$', '$L_{A_{\\min}}$', '$CV_{A_{\\min}}$', 
  '$A_{\\max}$', '$L_{A_{\\max}}$', '$CV_{A_{\\max}}$',
  '$K$', '$m_{50\\%}$', '', '', '$Q$'
)

nrows <- length(par_names)

om_table <- data.frame(Parameter = par_names,
                       par_symb = par_symb,
                       c.value = rep(as.character(NA), nrows),
                       c.est = rep('Fixed', nrows),
                       p.value = rep(as.character(NA), nrows),
                       p.est = rep('Fixed', nrows))
rownames(om_table) <- par_names # stringr::str_split(par_names, ' \\(', simplify = TRUE)[,1]

om_table['Steepness', 'c.value'] <- cod_ctl$SR_parms['SR_BH_steep', 'INIT']
om_table['Steepness', 'p.value'] <- petrale_ctl$SR_parms['SR_BH_steep', 'INIT']

om_table['log of unfished recruitment', 'c.value'] <- cod_ctl$SR_parms['SR_LN(R0)', 'INIT']
om_table['log of unfished recruitment', 'p.value'] <- round(petrale_ctl$SR_parms['SR_LN(R0)', 'INIT'], 2)
om_table['log of unfished recruitment', c('c.est', 'p.est')] <- 'Estimated'

om_table['Std. dev. of log-recruitment deviations', 'c.value'] <- cod_ctl$SR_parms['SR_sigmaR', 'INIT']
om_table['Std. dev. of log-recruitment deviations', 'p.value'] <- petrale_ctl$SR_parms['SR_sigmaR', 'INIT']

om_table['Natural mortality', 'c.value'] <- paste(cod_ctl$MG_parms['NatM_p_1_Fem_GP_1', 'INIT'], 'yr')

                                                  'yr')

om_table['Length at 50\\% maturity', 'p.value'] <- paste(round(petrale_ctl$MG_parms['Mat50%_Fem_GP_1', 'INIT'], 1), 'cm')

om_table['Imputed age at 50\\% survey selectivity', 'c.value'] <- cod_om_rep$ageselex |>
  filter(Factor == 'Asel2', Fleet == 2, Yr == -2) |> 
  select(-Factor, -(Yr:Label)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Fleet, names_to = 'Age', values_to = 'Selectivity') |> 
  mutate(distance_0.5 = abs(Selectivity - 0.5)) |> 
  group_by(Fleet) |> 
  filter(distance_0.5 == min(distance_0.5)) |>
  pull(Age) |>
  paste('yrs')
om_table['Imputed age at 50\\% survey selectivity', 'p.value'] <- petrale_om_rep$ageselex |>
  filter(Factor == 'Asel2', Fleet == 4, Yr == 1920) |> 
  select(-Factor, -(Yr:Label)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Fleet, names_to = 'Age', values_to = 'Selectivity') |> 
  mutate(distance_0.5 = abs(Selectivity - 0.5)) |> 
  group_by(Fleet) |> 
  filter(distance_0.5 == min(distance_0.5)) |>
  pull(Age) |>
  paste('yrs')
om_table['Imputed age at 50\\% survey selectivity', c('c.est', 'p.est')] <- 'Estimated'

om_table['Adult survey catchability', 'c.value'] <- exp(cod_ctl$Q_parms['LnQ_base_Survey(2)', 'INIT'])
om_table['Adult survey catchability', 'p.value'] <- round(exp(petrale_ctl$Q_parms['LnQ_base_WCGBTS(4)', 'INIT']), 2)
om_table['Adult survey catchability', 'p.est'] <- 'Float'

rownames(om_table) <- NULL
om_table |>
# 1. Data transformation using dplyr and stringr
  mutate(
    # Combine Parameter and Symbol with pattern "{1} ({2})"
    Parameter = paste0(Parameter, " (", par_symb, ")"),
    
    # Remove empty parentheses " ()"
    Parameter = stringr::str_remove(Parameter, " \\(\\)"),
    
    # Apply superscript -1 to row 4 of the value columns
    # Natural mortality is row 4
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = c(c.value, p.value),
      .fns = ~ if_else(row_number() == 4, paste0(.x, "$^{-1}$"), .x)
    )
  ) |>
  select(-par_symb) |>
# 2. Render with kableExtra
  kableExtra::kbl(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE,        # Crucial: allows LaTeX math ($h$, $\sigma_R$, etc.)
    align = "l",
    caption = "Operating model parameters and their treatment in estimation models",
    col.names = c("Parameter", "Value", "Treatment", "Value", "Treatment")
  ) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), # Forces the table to stay exactly "here" [H]
    font_size = 10,
    full_width = TRUE
  ) |>
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Atlantic cod" = 2, "Petrale sole" = 2))
```

```{r}
#| label: petrale-table

petrale_em <- SS_read('simulations/petrale/no.ind/1/em')
petrale_age_smry <- petrale_em$dat$agecomp |>
  # collapse CAAL sample sizes
  group_by(FltSvy, Yr) |> 
  summarise(Nsamp = sum(Nsamp)) |>
  # three sporadic years of data for fleet 2 before 2003
  filter(Yr >= 2003 | FltSvy != 2) |>
  # add zeros for missing years
  full_join(data.frame(Yr = 2003:2022, FltSvy = 2)) |>
  tidyr::replace_na(list(Nsamp = 0)) |> 
  # fleet 1 data collection rates increased ~2008
  mutate(flt_grp = paste(FltSvy, ifelse(FltSvy == 1 & Yr > 2008, 'late', ''))) |> 
  ungroup() |>
  # count up and summarize sampling
  group_by(flt_grp) |> 
  summarise(Nsamp = round(mean(Nsamp), 0), 
            min_yr = min(Yr) - 1922, 
            max_yr = max(Yr) - 1922,
            Fleet = first(FltSvy)) |>
  mutate(tbl_txt = glue::glue('{Nsamp} average ages from year {min_yr} to {max_yr}'),
         Type = 'Age')

petrale_len_smry <- petrale_em$dat$lencomp |> 
  # sporadic and very low sampling effort before these years
  filter(Yr > 1967 | FltSvy != 1,
         Yr > 1950 | FltSvy != 2) |>
  # sampling gaps and changes in sampling effort
  mutate(flt_grp = paste(FltSvy, ifelse(FltSvy == 1 & Yr > 2002, 'late', '')),
         flt_grp = paste(flt_grp, ifelse(FltSvy == 2 & Yr > 1993, 'late', ''))) |> 
  # count up and summarize sampling
  group_by(flt_grp) |>
  summarise(Nsamp = round(mean(Nsamp), 0), 
            min_yr = min(Yr) - 1922, 
            max_yr = max(Yr) - 1922,
            Fleet = first(FltSvy)) |>  
  mutate(tbl_txt = glue::glue('{Nsamp} average lengths from year {min_yr} to {max_yr}'),
         Type = 'Length')

bind_rows(petrale_age_smry, petrale_len_smry) |>
  mutate(Fleet = case_when(Fleet == 1 ~ 'Fishery1',
                           Fleet == 2 ~ 'Fishery2',
                           TRUE ~ 'Survey'),
         Type = ifelse(Fleet == 'Survey' & Type == 'Age', 'Age-at-length', Type)) |>
  group_by(Fleet, Type) |>
  summarise(Description = stringr::str_flatten(tbl_txt, collapse = ' and ')) |>
  bind_rows(tibble(Fleet = 'Survey', Type = 'Index', 
                   Description = 'Every three years from year 58 to 79 and annually from year 81 to 100')) |>
  kableExtra::kbl(format = 'latex',
                  caption = 'Summary of sampling effort in the petrale model. Note that survey composition data is only sampled in years with survey index data.', 
                  booktabs = TRUE) |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(3, width = '3.5in')
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-selex
#| fig-cap: "Size selectivity and imputed age selectivity in the Atlantic cod (a, b) and petrale sole (c, d) operating models. Note that Fishery1 age selectivity on petrale sole never reaches 1. This is because the length selectivity reaches 1 at lengths larger than the mean maximum length. However, the model does include individuals larger than the mean maximum length due to growth variability."
cod_age_selex <- cod_om_rep$ageselex |>
  filter(Factor == 'Asel2', Fleet != 3, Yr == -2) |> # fleet 3 = env, any year will do
  select(-Factor, -(Yr:Label)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Fleet, names_to = 'Age', values_to = 'Selectivity') |>
  mutate(Age = as.numeric(Age),
         Fleet = ifelse(Fleet == 1, 'Fishery', 'Survey')) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = Age, y = Selectivity, col = factor(Fleet), group = factor(Fleet))) +
  labs(x = 'Age (yrs)', col = 'Fleet') +
  scale_color_manual(values = inauguration::inauguration(name = 'inauguration_2021', n = 3)[2:3]) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = '(b)', hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank())

cod_size_selex <- cod_om_rep$sizeselex |> 
  filter(Factor == 'Lsel', Yr == -2, Fleet != 3) |>
  select(-Factor, -(Yr:Label)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Fleet, names_to = 'Length', values_to = 'Selectivity') |>
  mutate(Length = as.numeric(Length),

petrale_title <- cowplot::ggdraw() + 
  cowplot::draw_label("Petrale selectivity", x = 0, hjust = 0, size = 12, color = 'gray30') +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 7))

cowplot::plot_grid(
  cod_title,
  cowplot::plot_grid(cod_size_selex, cod_age_selex, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.45, 0.55)),
  petrale_title,
  cowplot::plot_grid(petrale_size_selex, petrale_age_selex, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.45, 0.55)),
  nrow = 4, rel_heights = c(1, 6, 1, 6)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-exploit
#| fig-cap: "Fishing mortality rates for the petrale sole operating model (a), and example catch time series for both operating models (b, c). Exploitation rates for Atlantic cod are assumed constant at 0.1052 yr^-1^ when they are non-zero."

exploitation <- petrale_om_rep$exploitation |>
  select(Yr, North, South) |>
  filter(Yr <= 2034) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Yr, names_to = 'Fleet', values_to = 'exploitation') |>
  mutate(Fleet = ifelse(Fleet == 'North', 'Fishery1', 'Fishery2'),
         Yr = Yr - 1922) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = Yr, y = exploitation, col = Fleet, group = Fleet)) +
  labs(x = 'Year', y = expression(paste('Fishing mortality rate (', yr^{-1}, ')'))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = inauguration::inauguration(name = 'inauguration_2021', n = 3)[2:3]) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = '(a)', hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5)

# could add horizontal line for cod to this figure?

petrale_catch <- petrale_om_rep$catch |>
  filter(dead_bio > 0) |>
  mutate(Yr = Yr - 1922,
         Fleet_Name = ifelse(Fleet_Name == 'North', 'Fishery1', 'Fishery2')) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(x = Yr, y = dead_bio, fill = Fleet_Name)) +
  labs(x = 'Year', y = 'Petrale catch (mt)', fill = 'Fleet') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = inauguration::inauguration(name = 'inauguration_2021', n = 3)[2:3]) +
  theme(legend.position = 'none') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = '(c)', hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5)


cod_catch <- cod_om_rep$catch |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(x = Yr, y = dead_bio)) +
  labs(x = 'Year', y = 'Cod catch (mt)') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = '(b)', hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5)

cowplot::plot_grid(
  exploitation,
  cowplot::plot_grid(cod_catch, petrale_catch, ncol = 2),
  nrow = 2
)

```

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| label: fig-term-yr-rec
#| fig-cap: "Relative error of the log of recruitment in the terminal year of the estimation model. Index is included in the *final* 10 or 30 years of the estimation model. Values greater than 0 indicate the estimation model is bias high (overestimating)."
ts |> 
  filter(year == 100 | year == 2022) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = model_run, values_from = Recruit_0, 
                     id_cols = c(iteration, scenario, species, sigR, nyr, indexSE)) |>
  mutate(are = abs((em-om)/om),
         rel_err = (log(em) - log(om))/log(om),
         sigR = ifelse(sigR == 'low', '"Low"~sigma[R]', '"High"~sigma[R]')) |> 
  group_by(scenario, nyr) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_violin(aes(x = scenario, y = rel_err, fill = factor(nyr),
                  group = paste(nyr, scenario)), linewidth = 0.5) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = 'black') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = inauguration::inauguration(name = 'inauguration_2021', n = 3)[2:3]) +
  labs(x = 'Index SE', y = 'Relative error of\nlog(terminal year recruitment)', 
       fill = 'Number of\nyears of index') +
  facet_grid(species ~ sigR, labeller = label_parsed, scales = 'free_y') +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-mare-ts
#| fig-cap: "Mean absolute relative error of relative spawning output at different levels of recruitment index uncertainty. Panels a, c, e, and g are time series that include the final 15 years of the hindcast period (white) and the full 12 years of the forecast period (gray), only for models with 10-year recruitment indices. Panels b, d, f, and h include the mean absolute relative error (points) and 90% simulation intervals of absolute relative error (vertical lines) at the beginning and and end of the forecast period, for both the 10-year (solid) and 30-year (dashed) index. Note that y-axes are only consistent within a column."
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7
#| out-width: "100%"
#| dpi: 300

mare_ts <- dq_long |>
  filter(nyr == 10, name == 'Value.SSB', year >= 85) |>
  ggplot() +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 100.5, xmax = 112.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "gray90") +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = mare, col = scenario, group = paste(scenario, nyr))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal) +
  labs(x = 'Year') +
  ylim(0, NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ species, nrow = 2) +
  theme(legend.position = 'none', strip.text = element_blank()) +
  NULL 

mare_ts_high <- mare_ts + 
  ylab('Mean absolute relative error\nof relative spawning output') + 
  geom_text(aes(label = labs), x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5, data = data.frame(labs = c('(a)', '(e)'), species = c('Cod', 'Petrale'), sigR = 'high'))
mare_ts_high@data <- filter(mare_ts@data, sigR == 'high')
mare_ts_low <- mare_ts + 
  ylab('') +
  geom_text(aes(label = labs), x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5, data = data.frame(labs = c('(c)', '(g)'), species = c('Cod', 'Petrale'), sigR = 'low'))
mare_ts_low@data <- filter(mare_ts@data, sigR == 'low')

mare_pts <- dq_long |>
  filter(name == 'Value.SSB', year == 101 | year == 112) |>
  tidyr::unpack(mare_bounds) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(year = paste('Year', year)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = interaction(nyr, year, sep = ':'), col = scenario)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mare), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = `5%`, ymax = `95%`, linetype = factor(nyr)), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~species, nrow = 2) +
  guides(x = legendry::guide_axis_nested(key = ':', title = NULL, 
                                         levels_text = list(element_blank(), element_text())),
         col = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal) +
  theme(legend.position = 'none', strip.text = element_blank()) +
  labs(y = '', col = 'Index SE', linetype = 'Number of\nyears of index')

mare_pts_high <- mare_pts +
   geom_text(aes(label = labs), x = -Inf, y = Inf, col = 'black', hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5, data = data.frame(labs = c('(b)', '(f)'), species = c('Cod', 'Petrale'), sigR = 'low'))
mare_pts_high@data <- filter(mare_pts@data, sigR == 'high')
mare_pts_low <- mare_pts +
  geom_text(aes(label = labs), x = -Inf, y = Inf, col = 'black', hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5, data = data.frame(labs = c('(d)', '(h)'), species = c('Cod', 'Petrale'), sigR = 'high'))
mare_pts_low@data <- filter(mare_pts@data, sigR == 'low')

# combine figures

shared_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(mare_pts + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal"))

label_cod     <- patchwork::wrap_elements(grid::textGrob("Cod", rot = 270))
label_petrale <- patchwork::wrap_elements(grid::textGrob("Petrale", rot = 270))

plot_row <- (
  mare_ts_high + mare_pts_high | 
  mare_ts_low + mare_pts_low |
  (label_cod / label_petrale) 
  # patchwork::wrap_elements(shared_legend) 
) + 
  patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(4, 4, 0.2))

label_high <- patchwork::wrap_elements(grid::textGrob(expression(High ~ sigma[R])))
label_low  <- patchwork::wrap_elements(grid::textGrob(expression(Low ~ sigma[R])))
header_row <- label_high + 
              label_low +
              patchwork::plot_spacer() + 
              # patchwork::plot_spacer() +  
              patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(4, 4, 0.2))

header_row / plot_row / shared_legend +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(0.075, 1, 0.15))
```
